crossRefs.note: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.
Wisdom is too high for a fool. He doesn’t open his mouth in the gate.
You shall make judges and officers in all your gates, which Yahweh your God gives you, according to your tribes; and…
then his father and his mother shall take hold of him and bring him out to the elders of his city and to the gate of…
Now Boaz went up to the gate and sat down there. Behold, the near kinsman of whom Boaz spoke came by. Boaz said to him…
when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.

translations.web: Her husband is respected in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.
translations.bsb: Her husband is known at the city gates, where he sits among the elders of the land.
translations.kjv: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sitteth among the elders of the land.
translations.asv: Her husband is known in the gates, When he sitteth among the elders of the land.
